comments.body: E2 round-2 caught a REAL isolation bug (G6 impact 1.0): plan's 'cp .tickets-tracker -> TMP_MUTANT_STORE' is NOT isolated because .tickets-tracker is a git LINKED WORKTREE (its .git is a file-pointer to the real object store; init.py:218,347-367) -> a cp'd clone's commits resolve to and MUTATE the real tickets branch (REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off only blocks push, not local commit).
